_help: What the pet can do when you talk to it. Keys are behavior names the AI picks from. Fields: when = hint for the AI, command = a firmware move (see the Lab page), face = an OLED face, sound = a sound from sounds.json, seconds = how long to walk (walking moves only), hold = ms to keep a face-only reaction. Firmware moves not listed here are added automatically. Moves already make their own sounds (playSound calls in firmware/movement-sequences.h); a sound here plays as the behavior starts.

greet.when: hello, hi, good morning, welcome back, bye, see you

come_here.when: come here, come to me, walk, go forward

back_off.when: back up, go back, move away

turn_right.when: turn right, look right, turn around

stop.when: stop, freeze, wait, no, enough, stay

loved.when: affection or praise: good boy, good job, I love you, you're cute, pat

excited.when: treats, play time, good news, are you ready

sad.when: scolded, bad news, someone is sad, I'm leaving

grumpy.when: insulted, teased, told off rudely, bad bot

think.when: asked to wait, think, or a riddle

confused.when: talked to, but the request matches nothing it can do (facts, chores, questions)

sleep.when: good night, go to sleep, nap, rest, lie down

wake_up.when: wake up, get up, stand up

show_off.when: do a trick, workout, exercise, pushups, show me your muscles

bow.when: take a bow, thank you, applause, well done

point.when: where is it, show me, look over there

shake.when: shake, shake it off, shake hands

spooky.when: be weird, be creepy, spooky, freak out

ignore.when: speech not addressed to the pet: background talk, TV, people talking to each other, silence or noise
